watch.summary: The creator confidently claims his team is solid on defense, only for a defender to get headshot and instantly killed seconds later.

beats.what: Creator listens to the match casters while watching the pro gameplay.
Creator mutters confidently, 'We got this, we're good on defense.'
A defender gets headshot eliminated immediately after his comment.
Creator stares silently at the screen in disbelief.

watch.author: mixed
watch.key_line: We've got this, we've got this. We're good on defense.
watch.why: The creator's confident declaration about defense is instantly jinxed by an immediate headshot death on screen. The perfect comedic timing makes the quick turn of events universally understandable.
